If b^2-4ac<0 there is no real number whose square is b^2-4ac, so there are no real roots. The quantity b^2-4ac is called the discriminant. Thus positive discriminant gives two distinct real roots, zero discriminant gives two equal real roots, and negative discriminant gives no real roots.

text: For a given metallic wire, the potential difference across its ends is directly proportional to current provided its temperature remains the same (Ohm’s law). V is proportional to I (11.4); V/I=R is constant for the given wire at a given temperature; V=IR (11.5). Resistance R measures opposition to charge flow. R=V/I (11.6); its SI unit is ohm, with 1 ohm=1 volt/ampere. Also I=V/R (11.7). At a fixed potential difference, current is inversely proportional to resistance; doubling resistance halves current.

text: Resistance of a conductor depends on length, cross-sectional area and material. For a uniform metallic conductor, resistance is directly proportional to length l (11.8) and inversely proportional to cross-sectional area A (11.9). Combining these: R=rho*l/A (11.10). The proportionality constant rho is electrical resistivity, a characteristic property of the conductor material. Its SI unit is ohm metre (ohm m).
